name: a state hall seen flat from the front: a cream panelled wall, a low wooden dais with two high-backed chairs under their wall plaques, two hanging lamps, a wall calendar of 60 days, a table with a ballot box and two envelopes, and a long table with a book on a stand, a checklist and a balance scale; no people
fits: anything about how a state office is filled or how a rule of the constitution works: a vacant seat, a deadline in days, a vote between candidates, the conditions for a candidate, two readings of one article; the hero is the pair of chairs on the dais, the camera pans from one thing to the next
recipe: flat 2D front view (no iso), one scale of 4 px a cm: a wall rect with tall stripes and a floor band that bleed past the frame, a taupe dais, chairs as a tall rounded back with a grey cushion, armrests and two legs, dark plaques with mono text, tables like a counter (a top slab and panels), a grey metal box with a slot, white envelopes, a green book on a wooden stand, a white checklist with round ticks, a grey scale whose pans hang level; no meaning colours in the dressing
